entry_rule: PAPER -> LIVE requires every entry gate to pass, including G1 (authenticated, timestamped, executable quotes), and a forward test on untouched games.
demotion_rule: LIVE -> PAPER when a demotion trigger fires. A demoted strategy returns to PAPER only and must re-pass the entry gates and a fresh forward test to become LIVE again.
suspension_rule: LIVE -> SUSPENDED when an integrity trigger fires. Suspension is permanent for that strategy id.
grace: performance triggers need 2 consecutive failing evaluation windows of at least 50 bets; provenance, redundancy and integrity triggers fire immediately

triggers.name: Signal decay
triggers.statistic: the trailing signal lift (hit rate minus the market's implied probability on the same selections) is negative
triggers.rule: two consecutive evaluation windows of at least 50 bets

triggers.name: Economic failure
triggers.statistic: the trailing return on investment at the recorded price is negative
triggers.rule: two consecutive evaluation windows of at least 50 bets

triggers.name: Adverse-price stress failure
triggers.statistic: the trailing return under a five-cent adverse move per original leg is negative
triggers.rule: two consecutive evaluation windows of at least 50 bets

triggers.name: Instability
triggers.statistic: the share of profitable seasons falls below the stability gate, or the most recent seasons lose money while the whole sample wins
triggers.rule: evaluated on the whole sample and on the most recent seasons

triggers.name: Redundancy
triggers.statistic: the strategy's bets overlap another live strategy's bets by at least the redundancy threshold
triggers.rule: maximum pairwise overlap of the bet selection keys

triggers.name: Quote provenance loss
triggers.statistic: the share of bets with a verified, timestamped quote falls below one
triggers.rule: quote coverage and quote-timestamp coverage on the live ledger

triggers.name: Drawdown
triggers.statistic: the peak-to-trough drawdown of the cumulative profit exceeds the limit
triggers.rule: cumulative unit profit over the live ledger

triggers.name: Integrity
triggers.statistic: a leakage check fails, or the frozen rule changed without a new strategy id
triggers.rule: the leakage test suite and the frozen rule registry

dry_run_note: No strategy is live, so the live register is empty. The register reports, for every candidate, which triggers would fire if it were live.
